# Companion code (test fixture)

The scripts behind every number of `../explainer.html`, a test fixture (not a real explainer): standard library only,
seconds to run. `checks.toml` lists them; `logs/` holds the output of the last run.

| Section(s) | Script | What it does | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.1, 3.2 | `hilltop_values.py` | omega, the cost still to pay V(1), the integral of L along the arriving motion. | numerical |
| 2.2, 3.3 | `steps/window_steps.py` | One step with the exact pair; the scaled candidates W = cV. | exact |
| 4 | `steps/speed_limit.py` | The clipped law with a speed limit: its cost, in closed form and by integration. | numerical |
